task.title: Keep the cookie for one domain

step.cmd: Sign in at the sign-in page. The server sets the sessions_pdomain cookie.
Save the localhost cookie named sessions_pdomain to sessions_pdomain.txt.
Sign out at the sign-out page, which replaces the cookie.
Load the localhost cookie from sessions_pdomain.txt.
Open the cookie report, and check that it shows sessions_pdomain=signed-in.
